methodology.source: official Bybit V5 public kline and open-interest API
methodology.selection: The event thresholds, local feature set, k, confidence margin, and three WaveField weights were fixed before the eight holdout assets were downloaded.
methodology.development_protocol: Each development fold is predicted only from outcomes that matured before that fold started.
methodology.holdout_protocol: Each holdout fold is predicted only from matured development-asset outcomes; holdout-asset labels never enter memory.
methodology.overlap_control: Candidate events are collapsed per asset until the 24h forecast horizon matures.
